_doc: Batch 01, Dace in the thermal bay. Fast, eager, over-explains, charming, stung by being managed; a Dawner who has never said so aboard; the expulsion is never named here (it is gated by knows.dace_expulsion and no storylet in this batch has that gate).

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: The sink curve on the bulkhead.

lines.text: Dace has the sink curve chalked on the bulkhead and is studying it the way other people study weather.
Look at that shoulder, it's beautiful. It's also the thing that cooks us if we're stupid. Both! It's both.
Dace starts to explain the sink curve and stops.
Sorry. I explain when I'm nervous. Sink's at thirty percent. That's the whole report.

source: act1_first_morning.md 1.2c: I'm explaining. I explain when I'm... it's fine

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: The cracked mug with a school crest.

lines.text: The cracked mug with the school crest is holding his pens again.
Don't look at the mug. It's a very good mug. It's seen things.

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: A spy novel, chapter nine.

lines.text: Don't tell me who the traitor is. I'm on chapter nine and it's either the cook or the pilot.
Not you, Fenwick, I can hear you thinking about it. Don't.

source: crew_cards.md: reads spy novels in the thermal bay

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: Abara said 'not bad.'

lines.text: Abara looked at my flow diagram and said, 'Not bad.' Two words, and I'm fairly sure one of them was 'not.'
I'm having them framed.

source: crew_cards.md: Dace most wants to impress Abara

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: Castellan says pipe tapping gives the reactor ideas.

lines.text: Castellan says my pipe tapping gives the reactor ideas. I said pipes don't have ideas.
He said, 'Neither do doctors.' Which is fair. Which is, hang on. Which is wrong.

source: crew_cards.md: rivalry with Castellan over who's smarter

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: Coolant readings and patient notes share a page.

lines.text: Dace writes in his pocket notebook, then squints at the page.
'Fenwick, left knee, grumbling.' 'Port sink, ninety-one.' I've put them on the same line. I think the knee's thermal.

source: crew_cards.md: pocket notebook mixes coolant readings with patient notes

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: You called him Doctor.

lines.text: Nobody's called me 'Doctor' in a while. It got into my head.
Doctor Dace. It sounds like a radio play. I'm not saying I mind.

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: His arrangement with Pell, after the burn.
storylets.needs: seen.call.dace.burn_1 and integration>=3 and not murdered

lines.text: Pell and I have an arrangement. I ask nicely, it answers precisely.
Best working relationship I've ever had, and that includes the ones with people.

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: Pell's grudge ledger, from Dace's side.

lines.text: Pell says I'm eleven apologies behind on the sink cooling. I apologised once.
I don't see how one turns into eleven. I'm not a bookkeeper. I'm a... well. I'm something.

source: pell_voice.md: grudge ledger against Dace over the sink cooling

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: Ames lived: Dace on shoulder wounds.

lines.text: Shoulder wounds like Ostrow's boy's are mostly boredom and infection.
I'd like to be bored on his behalf. Don't tell anyone I said that.

source: act1_first_morning.md 1.2c: I packed the shoulder before Dunne took him

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: Ames died: the music is down, not off.

lines.text: The music in the thermal bay is low enough that you can hear the pipes.
I turned it down. Not off. Seemed the least I could do.

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: A loose ship: music is allowed again.

lines.text: Music's allowed again, did you notice? Loud. The pipes are practically dancing.

source: command_model.md section 7: music in the thermal bay

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: A tight ship: his name in a box on the roster.

lines.text: There's a duty roster on the wall now. My name's in a box. It's a nice box.
I'm not saying I don't feel managed. I'm saying the box is nice.

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: After a bad hunt: cataloguing, not complaining.

lines.text: Hull took a hit and the sink took it worse. I'm not complaining. I'm cataloguing.

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: The sealed 'medical' store.

lines.text: Hospital-ship stores. If it's medicine, I want an inventory. If it isn't, I'd rather not know.
I'm having both feelings at once and neither one is winning.

source: act1_commission.md: DACE: It's from a hospital ship

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: High trust: you let him finish.

lines.text: You let me finish my sentences. Do you know how rare that is?
Abara's never once let me finish one, and I have never admired anyone more.

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: Low trust: stung, and he's labelled the valves.

lines.text: I've labelled the sink valves. If you want to check my work, the labels are right.
If you want to check me, I'd rather you just said.

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: Murder route: he checks whether anyone else can't sleep.

lines.text: Dace takes his own pulse, frowns, and does it again.
I keep checking whether I'm the only one who can't sleep. Occupational. Don't answer that.

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: Murder route: nothing wrong to report.

lines.text: I've nothing wrong to report, Captain. Everyone's healthy.
I wish that meant more than it does.

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: Murder route: he shields the notebook, then is ashamed of it.

lines.text: Dace writes in his notebook, shields it with his arm, and then, ashamed of that, lowers the arm.
Coolant readings. Just coolant.

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: Orbital maintenance background.

lines.text: Orbital maintenance, you said? Then you've seen thermal failures I've only read about.
Don't tell me about them. Tell me about them slowly.

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: The decoy turned, and his notebook says 'coolant, normal'.
storylets.needs: seen.shakedown.debrief and knows.decoy_turned and not murdered

lines.text: A hull full of nothing turned toward us, and my notebook says 'coolant, normal.'
I have never felt less useful or more interested.

storylets.speaker: dace
storylets.summary: Before the audit: labelled twice.

lines.text: Audit at Vesper. I've labelled everything in the thermal bay twice.
If it isn't labelled, it isn't mine, and I'll say so very clearly.
